speaker: Doctor
text: That is a concerning combination of symptoms, especially after recent antibiotic treatment. Have you noticed any redness, swelling, or warmth in the area of your flank pain? Also, have you experienced chills or nausea alongside the fever?

speaker: Patient
text: I have been feeling tired, feverish, and I have flank pain. These symptoms continued even after my sinus symptoms improved.

speaker: Doctor
text: DIAGNOSIS READY: Acute Pyelonephritis secondary to untreated UTI.
